name: SEO Articles Publisher
author: abiellc

sections.description:
SEO Articles Publisher connects your WordPress site to your SEO Articles Publisher account. Every day, the SEO Articles Publisher service reads top headline news, rewrites the stories into original, SEO-focused articles that weave in your business — what you do, how you help, and a call to action — and this plugin publishes them to your site on your plan’s schedule.

  • Hands-off publishing — articles arrive and publish automatically (or as drafts/pending if you prefer to review).
  • Tailored to your business — your company profile (capabilities, tone, keywords, call to action) shapes every article.
  • Daily fresh content — sourced from the day’s top headlines, rewritten as original commentary with attribution to the source story.
  • Safe by design — content is sanitized on the server and again by WordPress before publishing; you control the publish mode, category, and author.

An account is required

This plugin is a connector for the SEO Articles Publisher service (seoarticles.abie.com), a paid subscription service operated by ABIE, LLC. The plugin does nothing without an account. Plans range from 1 article per week (Free) to 5 articles per day.

External services disclosure

This plugin communicates with the SEO Articles Publisher service at seoarticles.abie.com (operated by ABIE, LLC) to: register this site using the account email and password you enter (exchanged once for an access token; the password is never stored), fetch generated articles, report published article IDs, and send periodic heartbeats containing the plugin version, WordPress version, and site URL. No post content, user data, or visitor data from your site is sent to the service.

  • Terms of service: https://seoarticles.abie.com/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://seoarticles.abie.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Request an account: email help@abie.com to obtain credentials (a login email and password) for your website.
  3. Go to SEO Articles Publisher → Connection, enter your email and password, then click Connect. The service address is preset; advanced users can change it on the Settings tab.
  4. On the Sources tab, choose which news sources this site draws from.
  5. On the Company Info tab, describe your business — this is what every article is rewritten around, so the more detail the better.
  6. Set your publishing preferences (publish immediately, draft, pending, or auto-scheduled) on the Publishing tab.
  7. Articles begin arriving on your plan’s schedule, checked for fresh headlines once an hour.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without a SEO Articles Publisher account?

No. It is a client for the SEO Articles Publisher content service; an account (created by the service operator) is required.

Where does the content come from?

The SEO Articles Publisher service reads the day’s top headline news from major feeds, then writes an original commentary article tailored to your business profile, with a link to the source story. Content is AI-assisted and reviewed by automated quality and safety gates before delivery.

Will it overwrite or duplicate my posts?

No. Each delivered article is tracked by a unique ID; the plugin never publishes the same article twice and never touches posts it didn’t create.

What data does the plugin send?

Only what’s needed to operate: your account credentials once at connect time (exchanged for a token), acknowledgements of published articles, and a heartbeat with the plugin/WordPress version and site URL. Nothing about your visitors or existing content is transmitted.

Can I review articles before they go live?

Yes — set the publish mode to Draft or Pending on the SEO Articles Publisher → Publishing screen.
sections.changelog:
1.43

  • New Interlinking tab: automatic internal linking for SEO. The plugin turns the keywords from your Company Info into internal links inside your published articles, each pointing at your most relevant other page. It spreads ranking signals to your key pages, helps search engines discover your content, and keeps readers moving between related articles. On by default, with a links-per-page setting (3 recommended).

1.42

  • New Articles listing page: enter a path (such as “articles”) on the Publishing tab and the plugin builds a page there that automatically lists your published articles, six per page with pagination, styled by your theme.
  • New Publish button: auto-publishing now starts only when you press Publish on the Connection tab, after a readiness check that names exactly what is missing. Pause anytime.
  • New Read Me tab with step-by-step setup, shown first.
  • Support address updated to help@abie.com.

1.41

  • New Sources tab: choose which reputable world news sources this site draws from.
  • New Company Info tab: describe your business (what you do, tone, keywords, call to action) so every article is rewritten to promote you and build SEO. Standard keyboard characters only, with a live character counter on each field.
  • Each night the service collects the day’s headlines from your chosen sources and rewrites a story at random into an original article for your site.

1.40

  • Fixed connecting in wp-admin: the settings sanitizer was stripping the stored access token on save, so the screen reported “Connected successfully” but stayed on the connect form. Connecting now persists.

1.39

  • The Connection screen now tells you to email help@abie.com to obtain credentials for your website.
  • Moved the service address to a new Settings tab; you no longer set it on the Connect form.
  • More reliable connecting: the screen no longer shows a success message while the connect form is still visible.

1.20

  • Unified product versioning with the SEO Articles Publisher service.
  • Articles are generated on demand from each day’s top headlines, within your plan’s allowance.
  • New plan ladder from 1 article/week (Free) to 5 articles/day.

1.2

  • Claim/fetch/acknowledge flow with double-publish protection, encrypted token storage, drip scheduling, and the activity log.

1.1

  • Initial release: connect with email/password, automatic polling, safe publishing with featured-image sideloading.
